description: The period-doubling bit at index n, starting at 0. It is the parity of the exponent of 2 in n+1. Bit 0 is 0, bit 1 is 1, and the first 8 bits are 01000101. n runs from 0 to 999999999999999. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/period-double
